description: Creates a Claim Done case for a document and returns the questions the person needs to answer, with a case_id and access_token for the later steps. Nothing is charged at this step.

service.description: Service slug from list_services or match_problem, e.g. "letter-of-demand".

state.description: The person's Australian state or territory.

what_happened.description: What happened, in the person's words (2 to 6 sentences).

your_email.description: The person's email address: the draft, the receipt and the dashboard link go there.

your_name.description: The person's full name or business name, as it should appear on the document.

name: start_document
title: Start a document
